options.content: What boosting posts cost and what it bought, read by the bridge ${boosts_every}: Instagram's from your Meta ad account (the app's Boost button makes an ad there), TikTok's Promote typed in by you on the [Boosts page](https://@SITE_HOST@/ghost/social-preview/boosts/) (TikTok has no way to read them). *Seen* = accounts reached on Instagram, paid views on TikTok. A boosted TikTok's own views include the paid ones, so it's left out of the usual its other posts are judged against.
